answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 28555 Country: India Title: I had applied passport for my wife long back. I got transfer to Hyderabad and my family came with me.We contacted verification officer at police station that my wife won't be there during verification. I paid Rs 2500/- to the officer and verification was done successfully. Please let me know whether I can pay interest amount to pay this amount. Question: I had applied passport for my wife long back. I got transfer to Hyderabad and my family came with me.We contacted verification officer at police station that my wife won't be there during verification. He told me to submit all required documents and also demanded Rs 5000/- ,since they will take of my wife's absence during verification. I paid Rs 2500/- to the officer and verification was done successfully. Please let me know whether I can pay interest amount to pay this amount. Answer ID: 28555 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 27/24/L=1432) It is not lawful to pay the said amount with the interest money. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
